grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 44721 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so the table carries no exact duplicate rows and each row is a distinct invoice line event; no single column is unique on its own (invoice_id distinct_count 2330 and stock_code distinct_count 3141 both fall well short of 44721 row_count), so a derived identity over invoice_id, stock_code, and invoiced_at is used to carry the per-line degenerate key, and because duplicate_row_rate is already 0.0 this tuple need not absorb any duplicates, it simply names the natural composite key of the transaction grain.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice number such as 489434-489443 in the samples, null_rate 0.0, identifies the parent invoice a line belongs to and is part of the line identity tuple.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Boolean flag with distinct_values false and true and null_rate 0.0, marking whether the line represents a cancelled transaction rather than a measured quantity.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product/stock code such as 10002, 10080, 10123C in the samples, null_rate 0.0, identifies the product on the line and is part of the line identity tuple.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product description such as '12 PENCIL SMALL TUBE WOODLAND', nullable with null_rate 0.005098, likely missing when a product lookup failed at source.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units transacted per line, null_rate 0.0, ranging min -1395 to max 5184 with negative samples such as -1395 and -1043 indicating returns or cancellations that are summed across lines.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the invoice line event, null_rate 0.0, samples resolve to the minute (e.g. 2009-12-01T07:45:00, 2009-12-01T07:46:00) spanning min 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to max 2009-12-23T16:58:00.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Price per unit on the line, null_rate 0.0, ranging min 0.0 to max 1998.49 across 295 distinct values, compared and aggregated across lines.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Numeric customer identifier ranging min 12346 to max 18287, nullable with null_rate 0.300664, likely unidentified or guest transactions; it labels the customer rather than measuring anything.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country of the invoice such as Australia, Austria, Belgium in the samples, null_rate 0.0 with 24 distinct values, labels the customer's or shipment's country.

category_description: One row represents a single invoice line item: a product sold (or cancelled) on a specific invoice at a point in time, with its quantity, unit price, and the customer and country associated with that invoice.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_invoice_lines table enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, identifying its time column, grain, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that consumes this contract to emit gold models.
usage: The mapping contract rendered from this proposal is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted with datacontract lint, and reviewed by a human before approval; only after approval does the deterministic modeling engine read it to build the gold invoice_lines fact.
limitations: This mapping does not decide whether cancelled lines (is_cancellation true, seen in the boolean samples) or negative-quantity returns (quantity min -1395) should be excluded or netted in downstream analysis; it also leaves the 30.07% null_rate on customer_id and the 0.51% null_rate on product_description unresolved, deferring any imputation or filtering decision to consumers of the generated gold model.
